verdict.rationale: Docs clearly document a quickstart flow (create account, search offers, rent, wait for boot, connect via SSH) plus CLI/API/SDK access, with claims like 'Spin up GPU instances in seconds' and a verified working OpenAPI spec, supporting fast provisioning from console or API. However, independent community reports describe real friction — inconsistent host reliability/bandwidth, more setup hoops than AWS/GCP, and unreliable performance versus what's advertised — indicating the 'minutes to running code' experience isn't always smooth in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of actual time-to-running-code, and resolution of reported reliability/bandwidth inconsistencies.
